errors.text_span: След това стойността намалява до около 5000 килограма на хектар през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the value for dessert grapes (orange line) decreases to ~5000 kg/ha in 2018. The chart shows the value in 2018 is much higher, around 6200 kg/ha. The value was 5000 kg/ha in 2016, not 2018.
